craft_notes: Sthāyin: excess calls for distinction. Rows: blaze then grant. Read aloud: rising then bestowing.

lines: Where wisdom dawns or worldlings feast, there knowing flares high and the god-ring draws near — above all.
Weighing such heights, grant such pride of place to after-rite and the rest.
l4.sanskrit_cite: jñānalābhādau laukikotsavānte 'pi sarvatra saṃvidullāsādhikyaṃ devatācakrasaṃnidhiḥ viśeṣato bhavati iti tathāvidhādhikyaparyālocanayā tathāvidham eva viśeṣam anuyāgādau kuryāt
